subject: Avoid crash in genClusterInfoString when myself is uninitialized (#3173)
reason: The fix adds a NULL guard in genClusterInfoString so that nodeEpoch is not called on a NULL `myself`. `myself` is only ever NULL in one window: during clusterInit() itself, if clusterLoadConfig() hits a corrupted cluster-config-file and calls serverPanic (cluster_legacy.c:1445/1012) before myself is assigned at :1448. The panic's crash report (printCrashReport -> logServerInfo -> genClusterDebugString -> genClusterInfoString) then dereferenced NULL myself, turning a clean startup abort into a secondary SIGSEGV inside the crash handler.
